title: Integral exceptional operation and compact-support realization
statement:
theorem exists_integral_support_operation_realization
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω]
    [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω] (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (c : Compactification f) (E : FieldStage.{u} l) :
    ∃ A : Operation.{u} l Ω X Y (.integral E),
      Nonempty (LeftRealization.{u} l Ω c (.integral E) A)

proof.text: Construct the normalized reduction/total-limit operation on complete finite-Tor categories, transport its system adjunction through the recorded reconstruction equivalences, and identify its ambient realization with the proper/open compact-support image. Full finite-Tor inclusions provide the operation and left realization.
